stages.name: Implementation
stages.instructions: Implement the assigned Task in its own Git surface. First visit only: reply READY to the required initial instruction and wait for its addressed GO instruction before editing files; do not sleep or spawn background work. Later rework visits proceed immediately. Read /run/forge-source/descriptor.json using Node (jq is not installed). selected_revision is either an exact commit SHA or an unborn descriptor, which has no bundle. A moved target must be fetched explicitly with git fetch /run/forge-source/source.bundle +refs/forge/source:refs/forge/source and merged by its exact selected_revision SHA into your retained branch. This exercise starts with unrelated root commits, so use --allow-unrelated-histories when required; preserve both independent files. Never reset or discard prior work. Commit explicitly with local Git identity Forge Employee <employee@invalid>. Verify clean tracked/untracked state and record exact HEAD. Submit a work_report artifact describing actual changes and checks, then outcome completed with candidate_commit HEAD and its artifact submission message id. Do not claim success without committing.

stages.name: Independent review
stages.instructions: Independently review the pinned read-only candidate against this Task description. The first candidate intentionally contains only that Task's own file; do not reject it for absence of the other Task's file. After stale-base rework inspect the preserved combined result. Do not modify the source or invent findings. Submit a review_report artifact with actual findings and rationale, then the honest accepted/rejected outcome with candidate_commit equal to the inspected HEAD and that artifact message id. Rejected returns this same Task to work.

stages.name: Report-only QA
stages.instructions: Perform real task-specific QA on this pinned read-only candidate. For normalize-lines.sh choose and execute stdin examples covering duplicates, ordering and empty input; report observed versus expected results. For README.md inspect accuracy, requirements and examples; absence of the independently developed script on its first candidate is expected, not a defect. Source stays read-only; use private scratch if needed. No mandatory test framework or hook exists. Submit a qa_report artifact containing checks and observations, then honest passed/failed outcome with exact candidate_commit HEAD and the artifact message id. Failed returns this same Task to work.
